about:
Trendtex Fabrics & Tropical Paper Garden operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, offering a range of fabric collections sold by the yard. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks 234 fabric products across categories including cotton poplin, rayon poplin, polyester kapena, polyester knit moana, TC blend, cotton dobby, canvas, twill, yarn-dyed palaka, and Hawaiian barkcloth upholstery fabric. Fabrics are sold by the full yard and packed as continuous yardage per item unless otherwise communicated.

The fabric selections serve apparel, upholstery, and home décor markets, with materials such as 100% cotton poplin for shirts and dresses, rayon poplin for lightweight garments, and barkcloth for furniture upholstery. Customers include designers, manufacturers, and retail buyers seeking Hawaiian-inspired textiles.

Trendtex emphasizes continuous-yardage packing and a broad in-stock assortment of Hawaiian-themed fabrics, positioning itself as a major supplier of barkcloth upholstery material in the region.
